name: Cardiology & Cardiac Surgery
description: Interventional cardiology and cardiac surgery: angioplasty, bypass (CABG), valve repair and replacement, TAVI, pacemakers and congenital heart repair by high-volume heart teams.

name: Orthopedics & Joint Replacement
description: Knee, hip and shoulder replacement, sports injuries and arthroscopy with computer-navigated and robotic-assisted options and in-hospital physiotherapy.

name: Cosmetic & Plastic Surgery
description: Aesthetic and reconstructive procedures such as rhinoplasty, liposuction, tummy tuck, breast surgery and hair restoration by board-certified plastic surgeons.

name: Dental Care
description: Implants, full-mouth rehabilitation, root canal treatment, crowns and veneers planned with 3D scans; many treatments fit into a one- or two-week trip.

name: Oncology (Cancer Care)
description: Multidisciplinary cancer care: tumour-board review, chemotherapy and immunotherapy, precision radiotherapy, radiosurgery and cancer surgery.

name: Neurology & Neurosurgery
description: Brain and nerve care including brain tumour surgery, aneurysm treatment, epilepsy surgery and deep brain stimulation for movement disorders.

name: Fertility & IVF
description: IUI, IVF, ICSI and fertility preservation delivered under India's Assisted Reproductive Technology regulations, with counselling throughout.

name: Organ & Bone Marrow Transplant
description: Living-donor liver and kidney transplants and bone marrow transplants. Organ transplants for international patients require a related donor and approval under Indian transplant law.

name: Bariatric & Weight-Loss Surgery
description: Sleeve gastrectomy, gastric bypass and non-surgical balloon options with dietitian and psychologist support before and after surgery.

name: Ophthalmology (Eye Care)
description: Laser vision correction, premium cataract surgery, corneal transplant and retina surgery, mostly as day-care procedures.

name: Spine Surgery
description: Minimally invasive and open spine surgery: slipped disc, spinal fusion, artificial disc replacement and scoliosis correction with neuro-monitoring.

name: Urology
description: Kidney stone removal, prostate enlargement surgery and robotic cancer surgery using laser and endoscopic techniques.

name: Gastroenterology & GI Surgery
description: Keyhole gallbladder, hernia and colorectal surgery plus advanced endoscopy for digestive and liver conditions.

name: ENT (Ear, Nose & Throat)
description: Cochlear implants, endoscopic sinus surgery, tonsillectomy and thyroid surgery for adults and children.

name: Nephrology & Dialysis
description: Kidney care for international patients: haemodialysis while in India, dialysis access surgery and transplant work-up.

name: Wellness & Preventive Health
description: Comprehensive health check-ups and supervised Ayurveda and lifestyle programmes alongside conventional medical oversight.
